key_insight: 1-acetylpiperazine (PX) couples crystallization control with interface passivation to improve lead-free tin-perovskite solar cells.
engineering_relevance: A dynamically transforming additive offers a route to address rapid crystallization and interfacial defects within one film-processing strategy.
method: Coordinate PX carbonyl groups with Sn²⁺ to stabilize precursor complexes and moderate supersaturation.
Control crystal growth to produce compact, highly crystalline films.
Anneal PX-treated films to generate proposed amidinium-functionalized species that passivate surface A-site vacancies.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports 15.18% power conversion efficiency and retention of 94.1% of initial efficiency after 500 hours of continuous illumination.
watch_item: The proposed amidinium-forming transformation needs stronger mechanistic confirmation, and the abstract does not specify illumination-test conditions.
paper_title: Dynamic Molecular Transformation Mediated Crystallization Regulation and Interface Passivation in Tin Based Perovskite Solar Cells
